tools.name: add_dashboard_page
tools.description: Add one dashboard page to a private draft using an exact expected revision.

tools.name: add_dashboard_visual
tools.description: Add a governed dashboard visual to a private draft using an exact expected revision.

tools.name: assign_dashboard_field
tools.description: Assign one governed semantic field to a dashboard visual in a private draft using an exact expected revision.

tools.name: catalog_get
tools.description: Resolve one exact authorized project resource ID and return its compact metadata.

tools.name: catalog_list
tools.description: Browse authorized project resources. Returned refs are exact stable IDs for subsequent calls.

tools.name: catalog_search
tools.description: Search authorized project resources by stable ID, name, description, or domain metadata.

tools.name: create_dashboard_draft
tools.description: Create a private dashboard draft owned by the authenticated principal. Agent retries that reuse the same invocation identity and payload replay the original draft; reusing that identity with a different payload is rejected.

tools.name: docs_read
tools.description: Read a bounded line window from one LeapView document returned by docs_search. Continue with nextOffset when truncated is true.

id.description: Stable doc:<path> ID returned by docs_search.

limit.description: Maximum lines to read; defaults to 200 and is also byte-bounded.

offset.description: First line to read, starting at 1; defaults to 1.

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Search LeapView's version-matched product documentation. Returns ranked, bounded matches with stable document IDs and excerpts. Continue with nextCursor when hasMore is true, or use the optional path prefix to narrow broad searches.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous call with the same query and path.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return; defaults to 8.

path.description: Optional documentation path prefix, such as guides/build, api, cli, or visuals.

query.description: Words or phrases to find in LeapView documentation.

tools.name: execute_dashboard_command
tools.description: Publish or archive one dashboard authoring revision using a closed, typed command and exact expected revision. Actor and agent provenance are server-bound.

tools.name: export_dashboard_yaml
tools.description: Export an authorized authored dashboard source as canonical project YAML.

tools.name: fork_dashboard
tools.description: Fork an authorized project or instance dashboard source into a private draft. Agent retries that reuse the same invocation identity and payload replay the original draft.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Get one authorized dashboard's governed metadata.

tools.name: get_dashboard_draft
tools.description: Read the exact current private draft and retained revision for one dashboard.

tools.name: list_dashboards
tools.description: List the authorized project dashboard catalog.

tools.name: preview_dashboard_draft
tools.description: Preview an exact private dashboard draft revision and page against the active governed runtime.

tools.name: query_dashboard_visual
tools.description: Query an existing dashboard visual with governed filters and compact analytical output

dashboard.description: Stable dashboard resource ID to query.

lastSuccessfulRefreshAt.description: Completion time of the last successful publish or refresh. This is not an upstream event-time watermark.

servingStateId.description: Serving state that produced the successful data version.

snapshotId.description: DuckLake snapshot ID recorded for the successful data version.

source.description: Whether the data version came from publish or refresh.

status.description: current when the successful data version belongs to the queried serving snapshot; stale otherwise.
